Deadlift day — barbell deadlift + accessories, 10,740 kg

en.eNote: No meals logged for Aug 28 – Sep 3 (last intake log: Jun 14), so the energy and burn charts assume the 2,000 kcal plan. Garmin active burn averaged ~452 kcal/day, down from ~535 on the Sep 2 board — the window lost Thursday's 622 and gained Wednesday's 43, so the fall is window turnover plus a real rest day, not a lighter training week. Sunday's hike is still the biggest day by a distance at 1,236 kcal, ahead of Tuesday's deadlift day at 698, Saturday's front squat 570 and Monday's swim 525. Friday's rest day reads 93 across 5,807 steps, Wednesday's reads 43 across 2,249 — the quietest day in the window — and today reads 0: 19 steps and 5 seconds of active time as of 09:08.
en.bNote: Net exercise = Garmin active calories; standing BMR 2,414 (today's Garmin BMR reads 656 because the day just started). Intake assumes 2,000 kcal all seven days (none logged after Jun 14), so the implied balance ≈ −866 kcal/day is exercise-driven, not measured. Sunday's hike alone implies ≈ −1,650, Tuesday's deadlift day ≈ −1,112, Saturday's front squat ≈ −984 and Monday's swim ≈ −939; Friday's rest day implies ≈ −507, Wednesday's ≈ −457 and today ≈ −414 on these assumptions.
en.wNote: Bridge shows the last logged meals (Jun 12–14) — no intake was logged for the displayed week. Negative balance = deficit.
en.i1t: Four sessions as the hack squat day rolls out — and three empty days
en.i1: The window now runs Friday to Thursday and three of the seven days are empty: Friday, Wednesday and today so far. Four sessions, 8h 05m, 20,615 kg, 3,676 active kcal — well down from the Sep 2 board (5 sessions, 9h 30m, 36,377 kg, 4,315 kcal), and almost all of that is Thursday's hack squat day rolling out of the window: 85 minutes, 15,762 kg and 639 kcal, on its own three quarters of the tonnage gap. Nothing new came in to replace it. Wednesday was a genuine rest day at 43 active kcal and 2,249 steps, the quietest day of the block, so what remains is the same four sessions the last board already carried. Tuesday's Barbell DEAD LIFT is still the newest and the highest gym effort at 43: 75 minutes, 18 sets, 242 reps, 10,740 kg, avg HR 122, max 157, 728 active kcal — and still the first real progression on that lift in a fortnight, 120 kg for 8/8/10 at RPE 8/8/9 against 8/8/8 at 8/8.5/8.5 on Aug 25. Sunday's Zagreb hike remains the largest single piece of the week: 4h 24m, 11.7 km, avg HR 91, max 144, 1,645 active kcal, 15,765 steps, effort 83 on volume rather than intensity, since avg HR 91 sits barely above the 53 resting anchor. Saturday's front squat day was 84 minutes, 21 sets, 220 reps, 9,875 kg, avg HR 112, max 150. Monday's 2,200 m swim as 10×100 + 10×50 ran 62 minutes at avg HR 121, max 147.
en.i2t: Fifth board with no tracked lift — and the goblet squat is out of excuses
en.i2: Nothing tracked has been run since Jun 20, so the per-set HR chart is unchanged for a fifth refresh running. Goblet squat is now 84 days out from Jun 11 and remains the oldest hole on the board. Trap-bar deadlift is 75 days from Jun 20 and stays blocked until roughly Sep 9 by Tuesday's 120 kg barbell pulls. Hack squat was seven days ago, so it is technically available again — but it also owns the last four points on the chart and all four carry the uncertain flag; the most recent confident per-set reading on any lift is Jul 7, fifty-eight days back. Another hack squat block would add a fifth doubtful point rather than a clean one. The goblet is the one worth running: four working sets at 48 kg, one uninterrupted HR block, roughly 20 minutes, and it would be that lift's first point since Jun 11 and the chart's first confident reading since Jul 7. It has now been asked for on three consecutive refreshes and passed over three times, twice in favour of a heavier session. The usual objection — save it for a low-readiness day — does not apply this morning either: readiness is 87, the highest of the block, so there is room to run the goblet inside a fuller session rather than instead of one.
en.i3t: Data quality: complete, one chart caveat
en.i3: Hevy and Intervals.icu were both synced at the start of this refresh and nothing is missing. Hevy holds full set-by-set data with RPE on every set of both lifting days in the window, so 9,875 kg and 10,740 kg are measured rather than estimated — that is five boards running with complete RPE logging. Friday and Wednesday are real rest days, not sync gaps: 93 kcal on 5,807 steps and 43 kcal on 2,249 steps, daily max HR 98 and 99, no activity files. Sunday's hike is Garmin-only, as a hike should be. Today has nothing yet — 0 active kcal, 19 steps, 5 seconds of active time as of 09:08. Sleep is complete across the displayed window: all seven evening slots from Thu 27 to Wed 2 are recorded and last night validated ENHANCED_FINAL. The one caveat belongs to the board rather than the data: the chart axes are fixed (effort 55, duration 95m, kcal 950, distance 2,500m) and Sunday's hike still exceeds all four, so its bar is clipped on those views — read the hike from the tooltip, not the bar height.
en.i4t: Recovery: HRV fully back, best autonomic picture of the block
en.i4: Last night scored 82 on 6h 58m, 23:33 to 06:37 — three points under the night before and two minutes under the 7h 00m average, so an ordinary night on duration and the best one here on everything else. HRV came in at 45, up six from 39 and four over the 41 average, second-highest of the seven and a full recovery of the ten points Tuesday's deadlift day cost. RHR held 53 for a fourth straight night, tied lowest and one under the 54 baseline. Average stress read 13, the lowest in the window against 26 the day before, and body battery charged to 94 yesterday, the highest ceiling of the seven. Six minutes awake, 99% efficiency, second-cleanest night on the board behind Sunday evening's zero. The stages are where the score went: light 4h 27m at 64%, REM 1h 24m at 20%, deep 1h 07m at 16%, so deep and REM together made only 2h 31m — 36% of the night, the lowest restorative share of the seven. Garmin marked total duration and REM percentage fair and everything else good or better. Readiness 87, the highest of this block. Wednesday's rest day did exactly what a rest day is for.
en.rec: Train hard today — this is the green light you were holding out for. Readiness 87, HRV back to 45, RHR at its 53 floor, average stress 13, and a full rest day behind you: the autonomic bill from Tuesday's deadlifts is paid, and delaying heavy work further now costs more than it protects. The session to run is the goblet squat, asked for on three consecutive refreshes and skipped three times. It is the oldest gap on the board at 84 days, trap bar is out until around Sep 9, and hack squat — available again at seven days — would only add a fifth uncertain point to a chart with no confident reading since Jul 7. Four working sets at 48 kg, even rest intervals so the HR block reads cleanly, every set logged with RPE the way you have on both lifting days this window. That is a twenty-minute job that breaks a five-refresh drought, and at readiness 87 there is room to build a full lower-body session around it rather than run it alone. Add the second swim if you want the volume: only one made this window, and two per week has been the steady element of this block. Then the bedtime. Last night's 23:33 was 75 minutes later than Tuesday's 22:18 and cost 68 minutes of sleep; the board has now shown three times that duration here is set by lights-out, not by sleep quality. Get back to 22:30 tonight — the recovery is already good, the hours are what you keep leaving behind. Next: goblet squat today inside a full lower-body block, second swim today or Friday, bedtime back to 22:30, trap bar from Sep 9.

hr.eNote: Nema zabilježenih obroka za 28.8.–3.9. (zadnji unos: 14.6.), pa grafovi energije i potrošnje pretpostavljaju planskih 2.000 kcal. Garmin aktivna potrošnja prosječno ~452 kcal/dan, niže od ~535 s ploče od 2.9. — iz prozora je ispalo četvrtkovih 622, a ušlo srijedinih 43, pa je pad posljedica pomaka prozora i pravog dana odmora, a ne lakšeg tjedna treninga. Nedjeljno planinarenje i dalje je uvjerljivo najveći dan sa 1.236 kcal, ispred utorkovog dana mrtvog dizanja sa 698, subotnjeg prednjeg čučnja 570 i ponedjeljkovog plivanja 525. Petkov dan odmora je 93 uz 5.807 koraka, srijedin 43 uz 2.249 koraka — najmirniji dan u prozoru — a danas piše 0: 19 koraka i 5 sekundi aktivnog vremena u 09:08.
hr.bNote: Neto trening = Garmin aktivne kalorije; standardni BMR 2.414 (današnji Garminov BMR pokazuje 656 jer je dan tek počeo). Unos pretpostavlja 2.000 kcal svih sedam dana (ništa zabilježeno nakon 14.6.), pa je implicirana bilanca ≈ −866 kcal/dan posljedica treninga, a ne mjerena. Samo nedjeljno planinarenje implicira ≈ −1.650, utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja ≈ −1.112, subotnji prednji čučanj ≈ −984 i ponedjeljkovo plivanje ≈ −939; petkov dan odmora implicira ≈ −507, srijedin ≈ −457, a danas ≈ −414 uz iste pretpostavke.
hr.wNote: Most prikazuje zadnje zabilježene obroke (12.–14.6.) — za prikazani tjedan nema unosa. Negativna bilanca = deficit.
hr.i1t: Četiri treninga otkad je ispao dan hack čučnja — i tri prazna dana
hr.i1: Prozor sada ide od petka do četvrtka i tri od sedam dana su prazna: petak, srijeda i danas zasad. Četiri treninga, 8h 05m, 20.615 kg, 3.676 aktivnih kcal — znatno niže od ploče od 2.9. (5 treninga, 9h 30m, 36.377 kg, 4.315 kcal), a gotovo sve to je četvrtkov dan hack čučnja koji je ispao iz prozora: 85 minuta, 15.762 kg i 639 kcal, sam po sebi tri četvrtine razlike u tonaži. Ništa novo nije ušlo umjesto njega. Srijeda je bila pravi dan odmora sa 43 aktivne kcal i 2.249 koraka, najmirniji dan bloka, pa ostaju ista četiri treninga koja je nosila i prošla ploča. Utorkov Barbell DEAD LIFT i dalje je najnoviji i najviši napor u teretani, 43: 75 minuta, 18 serija, 242 ponavljanja, 10.740 kg, prosječni puls 122, maksimalni 157, 728 aktivnih kcal — i dalje prvi pravi napredak na tom pokretu u dva tjedna, 120 kg za 8/8/10 uz RPE 8/8/9 naspram 8/8/8 uz 8/8,5/8,5 dana 25.8. Nedjeljno planinarenje u Zagrebu ostaje najveći pojedinačni komad tjedna: 4h 24m, 11,7 km, prosječni puls 91, maksimalni 144, 1.645 aktivnih kcal, 15.765 koraka, napor 83 na volumenu, a ne intenzitetu, jer prosječni puls 91 jedva prelazi sidro mirovanja od 53. Subotnji dan prednjeg čučnja bio je 84 minute, 21 serija, 220 ponavljanja, 9.875 kg, prosječni puls 112, maksimalni 150. Ponedjeljkovih 2.200 m kao 10×100 + 10×50 odrađeno je u 62 minute uz prosječni puls 121 i maksimalni 147.
hr.i2t: Peta ploča bez praćenog pokreta — a goblet čučnju su ponestale isprike
hr.i2: Ništa praćeno nije odrađeno od 20.6., pa je graf pulsa po serijama nepromijenjen peto osvježavanje zaredom. Goblet čučanj je sada na 84 dana od 11.6. i ostaje najstarija rupa na ploči. Mrtvo dizanje s trap barom je na 75 dana od 20.6. i ostaje blokirano do otprilike 9.9. utorkovim dizanjem 120 kg sa šipkom. Hack čučanj je bio prije sedam dana, pa je tehnički opet dostupan — ali on drži i zadnje četiri točke na grafu i sve četiri nose oznaku nesigurnosti; zadnje pouzdano očitanje po serijama na bilo kojem pokretu je 7.7., prije pedeset i osam dana. Još jedan blok hack čučnja dodao bi petu upitnu točku umjesto jedne čiste. Goblet je onaj koji vrijedi odraditi: četiri radne serije na 48 kg, jedan neprekinut blok pulsa, otprilike 20 minuta, i bila bi to prva točka tog pokreta od 11.6. te prvo pouzdano očitanje grafa od 7.7. Tražen je tri osvježavanja zaredom i tri puta preskočen, dvaput u korist težeg treninga. Uobičajeni prigovor — čuvaj ga za dan slabe spremnosti — jutros također ne stoji: spremnost je 87, najviša u bloku, pa ima prostora odraditi goblet unutar punijeg treninga, a ne umjesto njega.
hr.i3t: Kvaliteta podataka: potpuni, jedna ograda na grafu
hr.i3: Hevy i Intervals.icu sinkronizirani su na početku ovog osvježavanja i ništa ne nedostaje. Hevy ima potpune podatke po serijama s RPE-om na svakoj seriji oba dana dizanja u prozoru, pa su 9.875 kg i 10.740 kg izmjereni, a ne procijenjeni — to je peta ploča zaredom s potpunim RPE bilježenjem. Petak i srijeda su stvarni dani odmora, a ne rupe u sinkronizaciji: 93 kcal uz 5.807 koraka i 43 kcal uz 2.249 koraka, dnevni maksimalni puls 98 i 99, bez datoteka aktivnosti. Nedjeljno planinarenje je samo iz Garmina, kako i treba biti. Danas još nema ničega — 0 aktivnih kcal, 19 koraka, 5 sekundi aktivnog vremena u 09:08. San je potpun kroz prikazani prozor: svih sedam večernjih mjesta od čet 27. do sri 2. je zabilježeno, a zadnja noć je validirana kao ENHANCED_FINAL. Jedna ograda vrijedi za ploču, a ne za podatke: osi grafa su fiksne (napor 55, trajanje 95m, kcal 950, udaljenost 2.500m), a nedjeljno planinarenje i dalje prelazi sve četiri, pa mu je stupac odsječen na tim prikazima — planinarenje čitaj iz opisa, a ne iz visine stupca.
hr.i4t: Oporavak: HRV potpuno vraćen, najbolja autonomika u bloku
hr.i4: Sinoć je ocjena bila 82 uz 6h 58m, od 23:33 do 06:37 — tri boda ispod prethodne noći i dvije minute ispod prosjeka od 7h 00m, dakle obična noć po trajanju i najbolja ovdje po svemu ostalome. HRV je bio 45, šest više od 39 i četiri iznad prosjeka od 41, drugi najviši od sedam i potpun povrat deset bodova koje je koštao utorkov dan mrtvog dizanja. RHR se četvrtu noć zaredom zadržao na 53, izjednačen s najnižim i jedan ispod osnovice od 54. Prosječni stres 13, najniži u prozoru naspram 26 dan ranije, a body battery se jučer napunio na 94, najviši strop od sedam. Šest minuta budnosti, 99% učinkovitost, druga najčišća noć na ploči iza nedjeljne nule. Faze su ono što je odnijelo ocjenu: laki san 4h 27m i 64%, REM 1h 24m i 20%, duboki san 1h 07m i 16%, pa su duboki i REM zajedno dali samo 2h 31m — 36% noći, najniži obnavljajući udio od sedam. Garmin je ukupno trajanje i udio REM-a označio osrednjima, a sve ostalo dobrim ili boljim. Spremnost 87, najviša u ovom bloku. Srijedin dan odmora učinio je točno ono zbog čega dan odmora postoji.
hr.rec: Treniraj teško danas — ovo je zeleno svjetlo koje si čekao. Spremnost 87, HRV natrag na 45, RHR na dnu od 53, prosječni stres 13 i pravi dan odmora iza tebe: autonomni račun od utorkovog mrtvog dizanja je podmiren, a daljnje odgađanje teškog rada sada košta više nego što čuva. Trening koji treba odraditi je goblet čučanj, tražen tri osvježavanja zaredom i tri puta preskočen. To je najstarija pauza na ploči, 84 dana, trap bar otpada do otprilike 9.9., a hack čučanj — opet dostupan nakon sedam dana — samo bi dodao petu nesigurnu točku grafu koji nema pouzdano očitanje od 7.7. Četiri radne serije na 48 kg, ujednačene pauze da se blok pulsa čisto očita, svaka serija zabilježena s RPE-om kako si radio oba dana dizanja u ovom prozoru. To je posao od dvadeset minuta koji prekida sušu od pet osvježavanja, a uz spremnost 87 ima prostora izgraditi puni trening donjeg dijela tijela oko njega, umjesto da ga odradiš sam. Dodaj drugo plivanje ako želiš volumen: u prozor je ušlo samo jedno, a dva tjedno bila su stabilan element ovog bloka. Zatim vrijeme lijeganja. Sinoćnjih 23:33 bilo je 75 minuta kasnije od utorkovih 22:18 i koštalo te 68 minuta sna; ploča je sada tri puta pokazala da trajanje ovdje određuje gašenje svjetla, a ne kvaliteta sna. Vrati se večeras na 22:30 — oporavak je već dobar, sati su ono što stalno ostavljaš. Sljedeće: danas goblet čučanj unutar punog treninga nogu, drugo plivanje danas ili u petak, lijeganje natrag na 22:30, trap bar od 9.9.
